topic: fix printed pages coming out streaky or faded
core_question: How do I fix a printer that's printing streaky, faded, or lined pages?
answer_summary: Open the printer's maintenance software and run the built-in printhead cleaning cycle, then an alignment, replacing low cartridges if needed.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing terse one-liners

messages.content: printer output looks like garbage. all streaky and faded. fix it.
Streaks and fading point to a couple of things—have you checked whether your ink cartridges still have ink in them, or does this feel like a different kind of problem?
cartridges are fine. so what's wrong?
If the ink supply is good, what about the part that actually sprays the ink—have you noticed if it's always the same parts of the page that look faded, or is it random?
similar spots. just tell me how to fix it already.

Patterns like that don't sound random to me—when ink comes up missing in the exact same spots every time, what would that suggest is going on inside the printer rather than with the paper or ink level? Is there some kind of settings or maintenance area in your printer's software you haven't poked around in yet?
Worth a try—have you actually started it yet, and if you did, did the test page come out better or still streaky?
Sounds like it cleared the blockage—does this mean you're back to normal printing, or is there still a line here or there?
Glad you got it looking sharp again—doesn't that feel better than assuming you needed a whole new printer? Would you know how to run that same fix again if streaks show up down the road?
